channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: Bihar govt. restricts CBI power; State nod mandatory to probe against its employees
item.description: However, the notification issued by the Bihar Home Department on September 3, 2026, clearly stated that the CBI will not require permission from the State government to take action against Central Government employees

item.title: VTU asks principals of engineering colleges to dedicate time slots for student interaction and grievance redressal
item.description: The colleges have been asked to maintain a grievance log book. In the log book, the principal must record the date, brief nature of the grievance/query, and the action taken or resolution provided, wherever applicable.

item.title: Spotlight on illegal coal trade in Meghalaya after truck accident
item.description: A High Court-constituted panel has sought a detailed inquiry into whether the coal transported in the truck was legally auctioned or illegally mined

item.title: MLA seeks steps to address water shortage in Chittoor, Vaduthala areas
item.description: Drinking water supply in Chittoor and Vaduthala areas has been significantly disrupted for nearly a month, causing immense difficulty to residents.

item.title: Manipur tribe body seeks ‘impartial’ NIA probe in killing of three church leaders
item.description: The Thadou Inpi Manipur resents the sloth in the probe and says the lack of publicly known arrests has raised concerns about the transparency and credibility of the investigation

item.title: Traffic curbs in Kochi in view of police marathon
item.description: Curbs will be imposed on the stretch of NH 544 between SCMS, Kalamassery, and JLN Stadium, Kaloor; Aluva-Ernakulam PWD Road, and the premises of the stadium between 3 p.m. and 7 p.m.

item.title: 342 complete training at OTA; commissioned as officers in Indian Army
item.description: 17 from seven friendly foreign countries also complete training

item.title: China to proceed with Brahmaputra mega dam despite new concerns
item.description: Dubbed the ‘project of the century’ by Beijing, it has been included in China’s 15th Five-Year Plan for renewable energy; of concern to India is the impact it could have downstream, particularly in the aftermath of the recent devastating flash flood along the Nepal-China border

item.title: Documentary on wildlife in Tamil Nadu to be screened from Monday
Second homes, lifestyle upgrades fuel interest at property expo
item.description: Young women were among the prominent visitors at the expo, with many exploring property options and looking to make their own real estate investments

item.title: Kolkata school teacher booked for ‘forcing’ student to remove tilak
item.description: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari says an FIR has been registered against the teacher for ‘hurting religious sentiments’ and ‘humiliating’ the student. Such things ‘will not be allowed in Bengal’, he says

item.title: Rahul Gandhi will be PM candidate, says TNCC president
Eight years after chargesheets filed, trials in Gauri Lankesh and Kalburgi cases drag on
item.description: This week marked the death anniversaries of both Gauri Lankesh and M.M. Kalburgi

item.title: Man strangles wife’s male friend, dumps body in sump in Kolar
Assured transit-time container train service launched between Bengaluru and Delhi
item.description: The train will originate from ICD Whitefield every Saturday, providing industries with a scheduled and predictable logistics option for transporting goods to North India, according to South Western Railway (SWR).

item.title: Labourer dies after falling from temple tower while installing lights in Chickballapur
Eight High Court judges appointed as Chief Justices
item.description: Chief Justice of the Rajasthan High Court’s appointment comes amid a recent controversy involving Acting Chief Justice in the HC

item.title: The Hindu Made of Chennai treasure hunt takes participants on a city-wide trail
item.description: Pics by Johan

item.title: Restored Amma canteen in Arakkonam inaugurated
Malappuram DDC urges Centre to drop Palakkad rail division split
item.description: The move will affect rail development and passenger services in Malappuram, north Malabar, and Kasaragod, says Malappuram District Development Committee

item.title: NHAI trials reclaimed bitumen on stretch of Chennai-Tirupathi National Highway
Govt. gets ready for Kharif paddy procurement with ₹18,250 cr.
item.description: Minister Uttam Kumar Reddy says the estimated production is over 119 lakh tonnes; Govt. to procure 65 LT incl. 45 LT of ‘sanna’ varieties

item.title: Toddler dies after falling into water tank near Gudiyatham
DVAC holds searches at 30 places linked to K.N. Nehru
item.description: DMK cadre and office-bearers, including former Minister Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi, assembled in front of Mr. Nehru’s house in Tiruchi

item.title: Residents protest proposed stone quarry in Tirupattur
item.description: Residents said that preliminary work on the proposed stone quarry in Thengal village near Kalliyur was ongoing for the past few weeks

item.title: Tiruvannamalai gets auto stand for women drivers
item.description: Corporation officials said that around 250 sq.ft of space below a bridge at the entrance of the terminus was earmarked for the autorickshaw stand

item.title: Scheduled Caste panel issues notice to the Punjab government on quota implementation in lecturer recruitment
item.description: The complaint, filed by BJP MP, alleged that the AAP-led Punjab government had failed to implement the prescribed 25% reservation for Scheduled Castes and 12% reservation for Backward Classes in the recruitment of 1,013 lecturers

item.title: Traffic diversions announced for CM’s public meeting, foot rally on Sunday (September 6)
Road works worth ₹15.71 crore progressing rapidly in Ponnur constituency: Pemmasani
Applications invited for journalist awards in A.P.
item.description: The awards cover 12 categories, with cash prizes ranging from ₹1 lakh to ₹2 lakh; applicants must submit details and at least five works published or broadcast in 2025

item.title: Kanthapuram says will defend Shariat laws no matter whoever opposes it
item.description: Mr. Musliar also said that Shariat conferences would be organised in all districts to mark the centenary of the Samastha Kerala Jem-iyyathul Ulama. He claimed that there would be people who would talk about the Islamic laws till the end of the world.

item.title: Lokayukta registers suo motu case over lack of medical aid at Shivajinagar bus stand
item.description: The action was initiated by Justice K.N. Phaneendra, Upalokayukta, Karnataka.

item.title: Dairy conclave in Jhansi on September 11 as U.P. pushes women participation in rural economy
item.description: The Dairy Department said the objective of the conclave is to disseminate the advantages of various public welfare initiatives to eligible beneficiaries and promote rural economy

item.title: Javelin | An icon of modern warfare
item.description: The anti-tank system India is planning to acquire is a mainstay brigade combat team weapon for the U.S. Army and Marine Corps

item.title: Efforts on to capture a second tiger in Gudalur Forest Division
item.description: Forest Department confirms that this tiger is different to the one that killed two people in O’Valley in August

item.title: 71-year-old doctor loses ₹5 lakh in fake customer care scam
Peringamala gearing up to host Niravu farm fete
79 monoliths and a mountain of challenges: reconstructing a Nayak-era wonder
item.description: The initiative to restore the Veera Vasantharayar Mandapam at the Meenakshi Amman Temple in Madurai, which burned in a fire, ran into many hurdles. After an uphill struggle, a team of around 150 sculptors, led by sthapathi V.P. Velmurugan of Tiruppur, managed to complete the project, with the renewed hall being formally inaugurated on August 30

item.title: Overpriced popcorn, bottled water in multiplexes: Keralam govt. agencies begin inspections
item.description: Officials issue notices to representatives of multiplexes, saying that the prices are excessive, and that the matter will be reported to the government

item.title: Kanthapuram A.P. Aboobacker | Power beyond the pulpit
item.description: The Muslim cleric and scholar based in Keralam has faced criticism over his recent comments that women should remain at home rather than occupy public spaces

item.title: Woman alleges ₹1.5 lakh fraud in promise of CM relief fund assistance
Supreme Court wants affidavit on IPS postings in CAPFs, continues oversight of 2025 judgment
item.description: In an affidavit, the Union Home Secretary had informed the court that 46 IPS officers have been brought on deputation to the CAPFs up to the SAG level after the court’s 2025 judgment

item.title: AI university consultation panel holds first meeting, discusses phased establishment
item.description: The committee is chaired by Kris Gopalakrishnan, co-founder of Infosys and chairman of Axilor Ventures, and co-chaired by N. Manjula, secretary, Department of Electronics, IT, Biotechnology and Science & Technology.

item.title: NIA chargesheets 13 accused in espionage case
item.description: The accused trespassed into sensitive areas of vital importance, installed spy cameras and transmitted sensitive information to entities based in an ‘enemy country’, the agency says

item.title: Democratic Sangha launches Young Leaders for Social Change programme in Vijayawada
item.description: Young Leaders for Social Change (YLSC) programme is a four-month civic and social leadership programme designed for students from classes VIII to XII

item.title: Authorities probing ‘counterfeit’ rabies vaccine, says drug regulator
item.description: The manufacturer of the vaccine has denied producing the ‘misbranded’ vials bearing batch number KE25012 which failed a potency test by the Central Drugs Laboratory

item.title: Missing minor girl found in Haryana, accused arrested after three-month-long probe
item.description: The accused, a 21 year old resident of Upputuru village in Parchur mandal in Bapatla district, will be produced before a court under the charges of kidnapping the minor girl, with whom he allegedly was in friendship for the last couple of years

item.title: Tamil Nadu govt. shortlists Cheyyur, Gummidipoondi sites to build Chennai’s second airport; writes to AAI for pre-feasibility study
Ernakulam continues to report highest number of influenza cases
item.description: Of the 607 cases reported in the State in the first five days of the month, 274 cases were from Ernakulam. Five deaths were reported this month.

item.title: Hyderabad Police to step up security for Ganesh festivities
item.description: With the merger of the Shamshabad and Rajendranagar zones into the Hyderabad City Commissionerate, areas stretching from Balapur to Khairatabad will now fall under the city police’s jurisdiction for the festivities.

item.title: In Congress organisational reshuffle, Sachin Pilot gets poll-bound Punjab, Surjewala for Gujarat, Baghel moved to Assam
item.description: Ahead of crucial Assembly elections, the change in Punjab is most significant as it comes amid intense factionalism between the camps of former CM Charanjit Singh Channi and PC chief Amrinder Singh Raja Warring; Sukhdeo Bhagat made AICC in-charge of Chhattisgarh, Sirivella Prasad of Maharashtra, P.V. Mohan in-charge of Andhra Pradesh

item.title: Former wrestler, two children found dead in Maharashtra fort
item.description: Dharashvi police have registered a case of abetment to suicide and dowry harassment against Ashwini Pol’s spouse and her in-laws after a complaint was made by her father, Tanaji Shivaji Mohite

item.title: 18 passengers escape as KSRTC electric bus catches fire near Mysuru
Karnataka Governor directs action against KSHEC Vice-Chairman over alleged financial irregularities
item.description: As per the documents submitted by the complainant to Lok Bhavan, the Vice-Chairman has allegedly claimed reimbursement from the KSHEC funds for personal expenses and private entertainment.

item.title: Census advanced in four poll-bound States, deferred in Manipur
item.description: Poll-bound State to complete population enumeration before elections; Manipur exercise deferred amid protests and demand for NRC

item.title: Rise in fake UPI payment cases leaves merchants worried
item.description: Several such incidents have been reported from different parts of the State in recent months, with two silver merchants in Muvattupuzha being the victims in the latest reported incidents.

item.title: Dinakar attacks Oppn. over ‘misleading’ GDP growth claims
Former Delhi Mayor seeks action against police officers over house search
item.description: Police entered house at midnight purportedly looking for a journalist who had flagged the alleged misappropriation of Ram Temple donations, says ex-Mayor

item.title: Special NIA Court convicts 10 accused in 2013 Jheeram Valley massacre
item.description: The case pertains to one of the deadliest Maoist attacks in the country, reported on May 25, 2013, when a large group of Maoists attacked a convoy of Congress leaders, around 10km from the Darbha police station in Sukma district

item.title: Order on appointment of 1,600 teachers soon, says Samsudheen
item.description: General Education Minister says that 4% of posts would be clearly set apart for the differently-abled people to ensure the completion of the appointment process in a transparent manner.
